verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Adyen's risk/fraud tooling (Protect, rule builder, ML fraud detection) but contains no documentation of a chargeback/dispute management API, structured evidence submission, or dispute lifecycle tracking/status workflow. A vague community comment says Stripe beats Adyen on chargebacks 'hands down' but gives no concrete detail to substantiate a documented-capability failure, so it doesn't rise to a disputed claim — it simply reinforces the absence of positive evidence.
